'''Tegan Varss''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was part of Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]], where he acted as a treasure hunting expert.<ref name="The Old Republic" />
